mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which is often associated with a slowing economy and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in the supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face reduced output and potentially lower profits.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declines > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase significantly, it suggests a strengthening labor market, which can boost consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase, it signals a rise in demand for new homes, which can lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increases > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) both rise, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where both FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) both show strong growth, it signals robust economic activity and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 > 2.5% QoQ and RSAFS > 0.5% MoM.
